scene: Day 348, dawn in the street outside the depot gate. Nora (round white head, purple band on her right forearm, teal backpack) stands at the top of a ladder against the wall, painting big white letters SEVEN ALIVE on the hanging sign. Just behind the gate bars, the yard is packed wall to wall with thousands of green walkers, and the nearest ones are turning their heads up toward the creaking ladder, one in an olive vest with both hands flat on the bars. In the foreground, Patch (white round head, orange bandage above his right eye, orange backpack) grips the bottom of the ladder, looking back over his shoulder at the horde, eyes huge, one sweat drop. Tense because the whole yard is waking up under her.

Day 337, the bottom of a huge grey gravel pit with dried cracked mud. The beige coach, mud up to its hubcaps, roars to life nose to nose with the white truck, jump leads between them, while forty green walkers stuck in the mud pull their feet free and start toward the engines. In the foreground, Patch (white round head, orange bandage above his right eye) leans out of the white truck's window, eyes huge, one sweat drop, waving the coach on as its wheels spin in the mud. Tense because the walkers are closing in while the bus is still stuck.
